links.confirming_evidence: A frozen manufacturing release with the same platform topology and quarter supports the complete-system range.
links.falsifying_evidence: The source topology differs from GB200 NVL72, the source result is revised, or observed package output falls outside the linked range.
links.notes: Replaces separate illustrative logic-die, aggregate-HBM, and package-throughput constraints because the frozen manufacturing result already reconciles logic and packaging with every draw from the supplier-resolved customer-allocated HBM pool. Interposer and ABF constraints remain separate.
links.resource_name: Frozen draw-linked supplier-HBM Blackwell manufacturing system equivalents

links.confirming_evidence: Customer allocation, purchase-order, logistics, or receiving records support this share of the frozen manufacturing flow moving to the selected site.
links.falsifying_evidence: Allocation or receiving records show a materially different site share or that the manufacturing source covers a different supply scope.
links.notes: Creates the explicit scope transition from the selected manufacturing flow to a synthetic Abilene-target shipped subset. It is not an observed customer allocation.

platform_allocation.confirming_evidence: Dated customer allocation and site receiving records support a six-percent central share for the same supply population.
platform_allocation.falsifying_evidence: Shipment destinations, purchase orders, or receiving logs put the selected site's share outside four to eight percent.
platform_allocation.methodology: Synthetic share chosen only to exercise a customer-and-site allocation boundary between manufacturing and deployment.

links.confirming_evidence: A frozen site-operational release for the same site, platform class, and quarter supports the operational-rack range.
links.falsifying_evidence: The site scope or rack class differs, the source result is revised, or rack-level acceptance records fall outside the range.
links.notes: Replaces separate illustrative power and commissioning constraints because the frozen operational result already takes their minimum after site deductions.

scenario.name: GB200 supplier-HBM-draw-to-Abilene linked chain demonstrator
scenario.notes: Frozen draw-linked supplier-HBM manufacturing and site-operational results replace overlapping synthetic constraints. The generic full-chain link still maps source result quantiles; the site shipment share and all remaining capacity inputs are synthetic.
scenario.scope_notes: Accelerator-package through rack-integration outputs represent the selected illustrative Blackwell supply flow after every supplier-qualified and customer-allocated HBM draw replaces the aggregate HBM branch. A shipped-stage synthetic allocation narrows shipped, installed, and operational outputs to the Abilene-target subset. Supplier economics, consensus, opportunity ranking, and customer allocation are intentionally removed.

datacenter_operational.scope: One selected Abilene campus target-platform operational envelope.

manufacturing.scope: Illustrative Blackwell manufacturing flow whose aggregate HBM branch has been replaced once by all 20,000 draws from a frozen three-supplier customer-allocated stack pool.
